title: For Readers: Finding Your Next Great Book
use_cases: Use when seeking immersive escapism through fantasy world-building
Use when looking for stories that blend reality with subtle magical elements
Configure when filtering book recommendations based on reader mood
Implement when distinguishing between genre elements for marketing or cataloging
content:
Knowing the difference helps you find what you are in the mood for.

Are you feeling stressed? Do you want to just escape to a completely new place? Do you want to follow a hero on a big quest and see them win? You should look for fantasy. You will love the detailed fantasy world-building vs realism.

Are you in a more thoughtful mood? Do you want to see our world in a new, strange, and beautiful way? Do you want to read a story that makes you think about life, history, and love? You should look for magical realism. You will enjoy the subtle blending reality and fantasy.

When you know what these genres do, you can pick the perfect book for your mood. It makes your reading life richer.
